subject: refactor(ssh_dotnet): rename SSHDotNetPortForwardRules property to PascalCase
body:
refactor(ssh_dotnet): rename SSHDotNetPortForwardRules property to PascalCase

Rename the connection property and its serialized attribute strings (XML + CSV
write/read, CSV header columns, and the InheritSSHDotNetPortForwardRules inherit
flag) from SSHDotNetPortForwardRules -> SshDotNetPortForwardRules. Unreleased, so
the wire format may change freely. Serializer round-trip tests: 100/100 green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Renames property of fork-only SshDotNet protocol absent from our fork; also breaks CSV header compat. Nothing to apply.
